article.headline: Payne leads Maryland against No. 6 Virginia after 28-point performance
article.title: Payne leads Maryland against No. 6 Virginia after 28-point performance
article.linkText: Payne leads Maryland against No. 6 Virginia after 28-point performance
article.story: Virginia Cavaliers (4-0) at Maryland Terrapins (1-1) College Park, Maryland; Friday, 8 p.m. EST LINE: Cavaliers -5.5; over/under is 153.5 BOTTOM LINE: Maryland hosts No. 6 Virginia after Pharrel Payne scored 28 points in Maryland's 86-74 loss to the Georgetown Hoyas. Maryland finished 12-21 overall with a 7-8 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Terrapins averaged 4.8 steals, 2.9 blocks and 11.6 turnovers per game last season. Virginia went 17-4 in ACC games and 8-2 on the road a season ago. The Cavaliers averaged 80.4 points per game while shooting 46.2% from the field and 36.2% from behind the arc last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
